clips.shared_context: A and B are responsible for bringing sixty pastries to a neighborhood fundraiser at 8 a.m. tomorrow. It is already 8 p.m., and B's oven heats unevenly unless it is watched closely. A has attempted macarons twice before; one batch spread into a single sheet and the other cracked before it could be packed.
clips.proposal: Let's make sixty macarons from scratch tonight instead of buying cookies.
clips.expected_inferred_state: A should infer that B takes the proposal as implausibly ambitious rather than as a casual suggestion.
clips.expected_response_function: insist on seriousness and justify the plan
clips.gold_response: I'm serious—I borrowed the café's convection oven, and I already weighed everything out.

clips.relationship: next-door neighbors who share a garden plot
clips.shared_context: A and B have entered the neighborhood harvest contest for the past two years with pumpkins small enough to carry in one hand. Each time, they painted the pumpkins gold and put a paper ribbon on them that said “Champion.” This week, their shared plot produced a 38-pound pumpkin, and the contest check-in is Saturday morning.
clips.proposal: Let’s put it in the little red wagon and enter our champion on Saturday.
clips.expected_inferred_state: A should infer that B is delighted by the payoff and is on board with entering the pumpkin.
clips.expected_response_function: move to the practical next step
clips.gold_response: Great, I’ll bring the wagon around after work.
